## __Use cases__

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-007 · Raise a service request through the catalogue__

__Actor__ Requester · __Precondition__ Signed in via organisation SSO

__Main success scenario__

1. Requester opens the service catalogue\.
2. Requester selects a category\.
3. Requester selects the service item within that category — the second step\.
4. The template form for that item renders\.
5. Requester completes it and submits\.
6. Site, assets and priority derive exactly as for an incident\.
7. The item requires approval, so the request enters Pending Approval and the approver is notified\.
8. On approval the request joins the queue or is auto\-assigned, and is fulfilled\.

__Extensions__ — 3a\. The category has no items configured → the requester cannot proceed; the gap is reported to the administrator \(BR\-004\)\. 7a\. The item requires no approval → the request skips Pending Approval entirely\. 7b\. The approver denies → the request is closed with the reason, and is not reopenable\.

__Postcondition__ A service request exists, either fulfilled, in progress, awaiting approval, or closed as denied\.

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-008 · Approve or deny a service request__

__Actor__ Approver — typically the requester's reporting manager · __Precondition__ A request is in Pending Approval

__Main success scenario__

1. Approver receives an email carrying request detail and a link\.
2. Approver opens the link, or finds the item on their Approvals tab if already signed in\.
3. Approver reviews subject, description and requester\.
4. Approver approves or denies, with a comment\.
5. The request leaves Pending Approval\.
6. Technician, requester and reporting manager are all notified of the outcome\.

__Extensions__ — 2a\. Approver is not signed in → SSO carries them to the item without a separate credential \(C\-001\)\. 4a\. Approver denies with an empty comment → refused; a denial without a reason is not actionable by the requester\. 4b\. The item requires several approval stages → the next stage triggers rather than the request proceeding \(FR\-046\)\.

__Postcondition__ The request is Approved or Denied, the decision carries a comment, and three parties know\.

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-009 · Find a policy answer without raising a request__

__Actor__ Requester · __Precondition__ None

__Main success scenario__

1. Requester opens the policy catalogue\.
2. Requester searches or browses\.
3. Requester finds the answer — leave policy, holiday list, AI usage policy, an ISO or network policy\.
4. No request is raised\.

__Extensions__ — 3a\. Nothing matches → the requester raises a Request for Information, which is routed like any other request\. 3b\. The same question is asked repeatedly → the administrator is prompted to publish an article for it\.

__Postcondition__ Either the requester is answered without IT involvement, or a Request for Information exists\.

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-010 · Maintain the service catalogue and taxonomy__

__Actor__ Administrator · __Precondition__ Administrator permission

__Main success scenario__

1. Administrator exports the current taxonomy to a spreadsheet\.
2. Administrator edits it — adds categories, subcategories and items in bulk\.
3. Administrator imports it back\.
4. The system validates every row and reports what will change before applying anything\.
5. Administrator confirms and the taxonomy updates\.

__Extensions__ — 4a\. A row names an item with no parent subcategory → that row is rejected, named, and the rest still import \(BR\-004\)\. 4b\. An import would delete a node already used on live requests → refused; retirement is offered instead\.

__Postcondition__ The taxonomy reflects the imported definition, or nothing changed and every rejected row is named\.

## __Functional requirements__

![](data:image/png;base64,)FR\-034 to FR\-040 · Catalogue, taxonomy and templates 

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-034 · Service catalogue and request types__

__Description__ The catalogue from which a requester chooses what they need, and the three types a request may take\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Three types exist in the incumbent — Incident, Service Request, Request for Information \(EV\-049\)\. Type determines whether a second selection step and an approval path apply\.  
 __Source__ EV\-048, EV\-049 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved \(D\-003\) · __Applies to__ UC\-007

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST support request types Incident, Service Request and Request for Information\.  
 The system MUST determine which template, which selection depth and which approval path apply from the type and the selected item\.  
 The system MUST allow an administrator to add request types\.  
 The system MUST NOT allow a requester to change the type after submission; a technician holding the relevant permission MAY, recording the change\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-096 Given the catalogue, when a requester selects a service category, then a second selection step is presented\.  
 AC\-097 Given the catalogue, when a requester selects an incident category, then the form renders immediately with no second step\.  
 AC\-098 *\(negative\)* Given a submitted request, when the requester attempts to change its type, then the change is refused\.  
 *Fixture* catalogue\_seed — one service category with items, one incident category without\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The catalogue MUST make the distinction between reporting a problem and requesting something obvious without the requester needing to know the word "incident"\. · __Data__ Writes Ticket\. · __Telemetry__ catalogue\_viewed · request\_type\_selected \{type\} · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-096, AC\-097, AC\-098 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-035 · Two\-step service item selection__

__Description__ A service category carries a second selection step to reach the item; an incident category does not \(EV\-060\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-060 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-007

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST present subcategory and item selection for a service request\.  
 The system MUST render the item's template only once an item is selected\.  
 Where a category holds exactly one subcategory and one item, the system SHOULD skip the intermediate step rather than present a single\-option list\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-099 Given the Network category holding the item Request internet access, when the requester selects Network, then Request internet access is offered before any form renders\.  
 AC\-100 *\(boundary\)* Given a category holding exactly one subcategory with one item, when the requester selects it, then the form renders directly\.  
 AC\-101 *\(negative\)* Given a category with no items, when the requester selects it, then no form renders and the requester is told the catalogue entry is incomplete\.  
 *Fixture* catalogue\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Selection MUST be reversible without losing form data already entered\. · __Data__ Reads Taxonomy node\. · __Telemetry__ catalogue\_item\_selected \{category\_path\} · catalogue\_dead\_end \{category\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-036 · __Surface__ web · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-099, AC\-100, AC\-101 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-036 · Taxonomy structure__

__Description__ Category, then subcategory, then item — three levels, fixed\. __See Diagram 7\.__  
 __Use case and benefits__ The category export confirms the rule directly: software leads to MS Office which leads to install, uninstall and upgrade, while printers has no subcategory and therefore can hold no items \(EV\-123\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-028, EV\-123 · BR\-004 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-010

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST support exactly three taxonomy levels\.  
 The system MUST enforce BR\-004: an item requires a parent subcategory, and a category with no subcategory can hold no items\.  
 The system MUST allow a node to be retired without deletion, and MUST refuse deletion of a node used on any request\.  
 A retired node MUST NOT appear in the catalogue but MUST still render on historical requests\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-102 Given the Software category with subcategory MS Office, when an administrator adds the item Install, then it is created under MS Office\.  
 AC\-103 *\(negative\)* Given the Printers category with no subcategory, when an administrator attempts to add an item directly to it, then the attempt is refused with BR\-004 stated\.  
 AC\-104 *\(negative\)* Given a subcategory used on 30 requests, when an administrator attempts deletion, then it is refused and retirement is offered\.  
 AC\-105 Given a retired item, when a requester opens the catalogue, then it is absent; when a technician opens a historical request using it, then it still renders\.  
 *Fixture* taxonomy\_seed — mirrors EV\-123: Software/MS Office/\{Install, Uninstall, Upgrade\}, and Printers with no subcategory\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The editor MUST show the tree, and MUST surface a category holding no items as a defect rather than leaving it silently unreachable\. · __Data__ Writes Taxonomy node, History\. · __Telemetry__ taxonomy\_node\_created · taxonomy\_node\_retired · __Surface__ admin, api · __Traces__ G\-003 → AC\-102, AC\-103, AC\-104, AC\-105 → M\-003

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-037 · Taxonomy bulk import and export__

__Description__ The taxonomy is defined in a spreadsheet and imported, and can be exported back out\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ The incumbent has __no bulk import at all__ — every category, subcategory and item is created manually, one at a time \(EV\-063\)\. The Product Manager proposed spreadsheet definition \(EV\-064\) and then ruled that the new tool provides both import and export explicitly so a future migration away from it remains possible \(EV\-065\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-063, EV\-064, EV\-065 · C\-005 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved \(EV\-065, Decision\) · __Applies to__ UC\-010

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST import a taxonomy definition from a spreadsheet or CSV covering all three levels\.  
 The system MUST export the complete configured taxonomy, __including values never used on a request__\. *This corrects *EV\-030*, where a report export contains only values actually used\.*  
 The system MUST validate every row before applying anything, and MUST present the resulting change set for confirmation\.  
 The system MUST reject an invalid row by name and MUST import the remainder\.  
 The system MUST refuse an import that would delete a node in use\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-106 Given a spreadsheet defining 3 categories, 8 subcategories and 20 items, when imported and confirmed, then all 31 nodes exist\.  
 AC\-107 *\(negative\)* Given a spreadsheet where one row names an item with no parent subcategory, when imported, then that row is rejected by name and the other 30 nodes are created\.  
 AC\-108 Given a configured taxonomy where 4 of 20 items have never been used, when exported, then all 20 appear\.  
 AC\-109 *\(negative\)* Given an import omitting a subcategory used on live requests, when confirmed, then the import is refused and the in\-use node is named\.  
 *Fixture* taxonomy\_import\_seed — valid sheet, sheet with one orphan row, sheet omitting an in\-use node\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The change set MUST distinguish create, update, retire and refuse before the administrator confirms\. · __Data__ Writes Taxonomy node, History\. · __Telemetry__ taxonomy\_imported \{created, updated, retired, rejected\} · taxonomy\_exported \{node\_count\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-036 · __Surface__ admin, api · __Traces__ G\-003, G\-007, C\-005 → AC\-106, AC\-107, AC\-108, AC\-109 → M\-003, M\-007

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-038 · Request templates__

__Description__ A template defines the form rendered for a given category or item\. Templates are predefined per category for both incidents and service requests \(EV\-059\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-059 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-007, UC\-010

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST allow a template per category, and MAY allow one per item\.  
 A template MUST support text boxes, dropdowns, sections, and field types single\-line, multi\-line, numeric, date\-time and percentage \(EV\-146\)\.  
 A field MUST be markable mandatory, and mandatory fields MUST be enforced at submission and again at closure \(FR\-027\)\.  
 The system MUST version a template and MUST render a historical request against the version under which it was raised\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-110 Given a template with a mandatory dropdown, when a requester submits without selecting, then submission is refused and the field is named\.  
 AC\-111 Given a request raised under template version 1, when the template is edited to version 2, then the historical request still renders with version 1 fields and values\.  
 AC\-112 *\(negative\)* Given a template with a field removed in a later version, when a historical request holding a value in that field is opened, then the value is still displayed and is not lost\.  
 *Fixture* templates\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ A form MUST NOT present more than one screen of fields without sectioning\. · __Data__ Reads Template; writes Ticket\. Free\-text fields are Confidential\. · __Telemetry__ template\_rendered \{template\_id, version\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-036 · __Surface__ web, admin · __Traces__ G\-003 → AC\-110, AC\-111, AC\-112 → M\-003

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-039 · Template editing__

__Description__ An administrator edits a template by direct manipulation, adding or removing text boxes, dropdown columns and entire sections \(EV\-059\)\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Weak end\-user customisation is one of the four stated drivers for replacement \(EV\-002\)\. This is a direct instance of G\-003\.  
 __Source__ EV\-059, EV\-146 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-010

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST allow an administrator to add, remove, reorder and reconfigure fields and sections without a code change\.  
 The system MUST preview the resulting form before it is published\.  
 The system MUST refuse removal of a field holding values on live requests, and MUST offer hiding instead\.  
 Every template change MUST write a history entry\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-113 Given an administrator editing a template, when they add a section with two fields and publish, then a new version exists and the next request renders it\.  
 AC\-114 *\(negative\)* Given a field holding values on 12 live requests, when the administrator attempts removal, then it is refused and hiding is offered\.  
 *Fixture* templates\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Preview MUST render exactly what the requester will see, not an approximation\. · __Data__ Writes Template version, History\. · __Telemetry__ template\_published \{template\_id, version, fields\_changed\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-038 · __Surface__ admin · __Traces__ G\-003 → AC\-113, AC\-114 → M\-003

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-040 · Template creation from blank or by copy__

__Description__ A new template starts empty or as a copy of an existing one \(EV\-059\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-059 · __Priority__ P3 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-010

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST allow creation of a blank template and creation by copying an existing one\.  
 A copy MUST NOT inherit the source's version history and MUST start at version 1\.  
 A copy MUST NOT be linked to its source; later edits to one MUST NOT affect the other\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-115 Given an existing template at version 4, when an administrator copies it, then the copy is version 1 with the same fields\.  
 AC\-116 *\(negative\)* Given a copied template, when the source is later edited, then the copy is unchanged\.  
 *Fixture* templates\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The copy MUST require a distinct name before it can be saved\. · __Data__ Writes Template\. · __Telemetry__ template\_created \{origin: blank | copy\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-038 · __Surface__ admin · __Traces__ G\-003 → AC\-115, AC\-116 → M\-003

![](data:image/png;base64,)FR\-041 to FR\-046 · Approvals 

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-041 · Approval request__

__Description__ An approval raised against a request, carrying approver, subject and description\. __See Diagram 6\.__  
 __Use case and benefits__ Approvals are used in both Help Desk and Change; Change additionally supports multiple phased CAB approvals over the same mechanism \(EV\-081\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-081 · FLOW\-003 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-008

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST allow an approval to be raised on a request, carrying approver, subject, description and the parent request reference\.  
 The system MUST move the request to Pending Approval when an approval is outstanding\.  
 The system MUST allow an approval to be raised automatically where the selected item is configured to require one, without technician action\.  
 The system MUST record who raised the approval, when, and against which request\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-117 Given an item configured to require approval, when a requester submits, then an approval exists and the request status is Pending Approval\.  
 AC\-118 Given a request with no approval configured, when a technician raises one manually, then the request moves to Pending Approval\.  
 AC\-119 *\(negative\)* Given an approval with an empty subject, when it is raised, then it is refused\.  
 *Fixture* approvals\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Pending Approval MUST be visible to the requester on their own request, with the approver named\. · __Data__ Writes Approval, Ticket, History\. Approver identity is PII\. · __Telemetry__ approval\_raised \{trigger: auto | manual\} · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-117, AC\-118, AC\-119 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-042 · Approver auto\-population__

__Description__ The approver defaults to the requester's reporting manager\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ The incumbent requires the approver to be typed by hand\. The reporting manager is held on the user record and fetched automatically from the directory \(EV\-192\) but is __not__ pre\-filled into the approval, and the administrator does not know whether the tool supports it \(EV\-082\)\. The Product Manager stated that if the information is already available it should be pre\-fetched \(EV\-083\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-082, EV\-083, EV\-192 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-034 — registered as OQ\-012 in the evidence pack\) · __Applies to__ UC\-008

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST pre\-fill the approver from the requester's reporting manager where one is held\.  
 The system MUST allow a technician holding the relevant permission to change the approver, recording the change and a reason\.  
 Where no reporting manager is held, the system MUST require an approver to be named and MUST NOT default to any other value\.  
 The system MUST refuse an approval where the approver resolves to the requester themselves\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-120 Given a requester whose record holds a reporting manager, when an approval is raised, then the approver is pre\-filled with that manager\.  
 AC\-121 *\(negative\)* Given a requester with no reporting manager held, when an approval is raised, then the approver field is empty and the approval cannot be submitted until one is named\.  
 AC\-122 *\(negative\)* Given a requester who is their own reporting manager in the directory, when an approval is raised, then it is refused and an alternative approver is required\.  
 AC\-123 Given a pre\-filled approver, when a technician changes it with a reason, then the change and reason are recorded in history\.  
 *Fixture* users\_manager\_seed — one user with a manager, one without, one who is their own manager\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ A pre\-filled approver MUST be visibly distinguishable from one chosen by hand\. · __Data__ Reads User\.reporting\_manager — PII; writes Approval, History\. · __Telemetry__ approver\_prefilled · approver\_overridden \{reason\_length\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-041 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-120, AC\-121, AC\-122, AC\-123 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-043 · Approver decision__

__Description__ The approver approves or denies with a comment, reached by an emailed link or by the portal Approvals tab \(EV\-081, FLOW\-003\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-081 · FLOW\-003 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-008

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST notify the approver by email carrying request detail and a link\.  
 The system MUST also present the item on the approver's Approvals tab\.  
 The system MUST require a comment on denial\. A comment on approval MAY be optional\.  
 On approval the system MUST move the request out of Pending Approval and into the normal flow\.  
 On denial the system MUST close the request with the reason\. A denied request MUST NOT be reopened; a new request is raised instead\.  
 The system MUST refuse a decision from anyone other than the named approver or an administrator\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-124 Given a Pending Approval request, when the approver approves, then the request enters the queue or is auto\-assigned, and the decision is recorded with actor and timestamp\.  
 AC\-125 Given the same request, when the approver denies with a comment, then the request is closed and the comment is visible to the requester\.  
 AC\-126 *\(negative\)* Given a denial with an empty comment, when submitted, then it is refused\.  
 AC\-127 *\(negative\)* Given a user who is neither the approver nor an administrator, when they attempt a decision through the API, then it returns 403 and the approval is unaltered\.  
 AC\-128 *\(negative\)* Given a denied request, when any actor attempts to reopen it, then it is refused\.  
 *Fixture* approvals\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The emailed link MUST carry the approver through SSO to the decision without a separate credential \(C\-001\)\. · __Data__ Writes Approval, Ticket, History\. __Reversibility__ a denial is irreversible\. · __Telemetry__ approval\_decided \{outcome, elapsed\_sec, channel: email | portal\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-041, FR\-042 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-004, C\-002 → AC\-124, AC\-125, AC\-126, AC\-127, AC\-128 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-044 · Approval outcome notification__

__Description__ Who hears about an approval decision\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ In the incumbent, __only the technician is notified__\. Neither the requester nor the reporting manager receives anything \(EV\-084\) — the Product Manager's response was to propose adding team addresses to a distribution list as a workaround \(EV\-085\)\. A workaround for a missing notification is a defect worth fixing in a rebuild\.  
 __Source__ EV\-084, EV\-085 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-035 — registered as OQ\-013\) · __Applies to__ UC\-008

__Functional requirements__  
 On any approval decision the system MUST notify the assigned technician, the requester, and the approver's own record of the decision\.  
 The notification MUST carry the outcome, the comment and the request reference\.  
 Which parties are notified MUST be configurable per request type\.  
 The system MUST NOT require a distribution list as a substitute for a missing recipient\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-129 Given a Pending Approval request, when the approver approves, then technician and requester each receive a notification carrying the outcome and comment\.  
 AC\-130 Given a denial, when the decision is recorded, then the requester's notification carries the denial reason verbatim\.  
 AC\-131 *\(negative\)* Given requester notification disabled by configuration for a request type, when a decision is recorded, then the requester is not notified and the technician still is\.  
 *Fixture* approvals\_seed, notification\_config\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The requester's notification MUST NOT expose approver commentary intended as internal; a single comment field is visible to all recipients and this MUST be stated at the point of entry\. · __Data__ Reads Approval; writes notification record\. Recipient addresses are PII\. · __Telemetry__ approval\_outcome\_notified \{recipients\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-043 · __Surface__ batch, api · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-129, AC\-130, AC\-131 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-045 · Approver licensing and permission__

__Description__ An approver is a standard user, not a technician\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Approval permission is not chargeable, unlike the eight technician licences, so approvers should hold standard user accounts \(EV\-191\)\. Per\-seat licensing is one of the four drivers for replacement \(EV\-002\) and this requirement makes sure the replacement does not recreate the constraint\.  
 __Source__ EV\-191, EV\-002 · BR\-007 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-008

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST allow any user to be named as an approver without granting technician permissions\.  
 An approver MUST see only the approvals addressed to them and the requests those approvals concern\.  
 The system MUST NOT impose any seat count, licence or per\-user cost on approval capability \(G\-001\)\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-132 Given a standard user named as approver, when they open the portal, then the Approvals tab is present and the item is actionable\.  
 AC\-133 *\(negative\)* Given the same standard user, when they attempt to open the unassigned queue, then access is refused\.  
 AC\-134 *\(boundary\)* Given 200 standard users each named as approver on one request, when all 200 act, then all succeed and no seat limit is applied\.  
 *Fixture* users\_approvers\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ An approver's portal MUST NOT resemble a technician console\. · __Data__ Reads Approval, Ticket\. Visibility bounded by §15\.7\. · __Telemetry__ approver\_portal\_viewed · __Prerequisites__ FR\-041 · __Surface__ web · __Traces__ G\-001 → AC\-132, AC\-133, AC\-134 → M\-001

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-046 · Multi\-stage approval__

__Description__ Several approvals in sequence on one request\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ The incumbent supports multiple phased approvals in Change \(EV\-081\)\. No source states that any service request uses more than one stage today, so this specifies the capability without asserting current use\.  
 __Source__ EV\-081 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-036 — capability observed in Change, not evidenced for service requests\) · __Applies to__ UC\-008

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST allow an ordered sequence of approval stages on one request\.  
 The system MUST trigger stage N\+1 only on approval of stage N\.  
 A denial at any stage MUST end the sequence and close the request; later stages MUST NOT be triggered\.  
 The system MUST show the requester which stage is outstanding and which are complete\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-135 Given a two\-stage sequence, when stage 1 is approved, then stage 2 is triggered and its approver is notified\.  
 AC\-136 *\(negative\)* Given a two\-stage sequence, when stage 1 is denied, then stage 2 is never triggered and the request is closed\.  
 AC\-137 Given a request mid\-sequence, when the requester views it, then completed and outstanding stages are both visible\.  
 *Fixture* approvals\_multistage\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Stage progress MUST be visible without opening each approval individually\. · __Data__ Writes Approval, History\. · __Telemetry__ approval\_stage\_triggered \{stage, of\_total\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-043 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-135, AC\-136, AC\-137 → M\-004

![](data:image/png;base64,)FR\-047 to FR\-050 · Information requests, knowledge and fulfilment 

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-047 · Request for Information type__

__Description__ The third request type, for questions rather than problems or provisioning\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Not in active use in the incumbent\. The stated intention is to host AI usage policies and ISO, IT and network policy catalogues there for self\-service \(EV\-049\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-049 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-037 — the type exists but is unused; the intention is stated, the design is not\) · __Applies to__ UC\-009

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST support a Request for Information type following the same lifecycle as an incident, without approval\.  
 The system MUST allow a Request for Information to be answered by linking a published policy article rather than by free text\.  
 The system MUST NOT require impact, urgency or asset attachment for this type\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-138 Given a Request for Information, when a technician answers by linking a policy article, then the article is visible to the requester and the request may be Resolved\.  
 AC\-139 *\(negative\)* Given a Request for Information, when submitted, then no approval is triggered and no assets are attached\.  
 *Fixture* rfi\_seed, policy\_catalogue\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The requester MUST be shown matching policy articles before submitting, so the request need not be raised at all\. · __Data__ Writes Ticket\. · __Telemetry__ rfi\_raised · rfi\_deflected \{article\_id\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-034, FR\-048 · __Surface__ web · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-138, AC\-139 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-048 · Policy and solutions catalogue__

__Description__ Published articles a requester can find without raising anything\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ The incumbent's Solutions module exists but is neither configured nor used \(EV\-050\)\. The stated want is a self\-service home for AI usage, ISO, IT and network policies \(EV\-049\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-049, EV\-050 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-038 — no source describes structure, ownership, review cadence or publishing workflow\) · __Applies to__ UC\-009

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST allow an administrator to publish articles with a title, body and category association\.  
 The system MUST allow a requester to search and browse published articles without raising a request\.  
 The system MUST offer matching articles during catalogue selection, before the form is submitted\.  
 An unpublished draft MUST NOT be visible to requesters\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-140 Given a published article on leave policy, when a requester searches "leave", then the article is returned\.  
 AC\-141 *\(negative\)* Given an unpublished draft, when a requester searches its exact title, then no result is returned\.  
 AC\-142 Given a category associated with an article, when a requester selects that category, then the article is offered before the form is submitted\.  
 *Fixture* policy\_catalogue\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Article suggestion MUST NOT block or delay submission\. · __Data__ Writes Article\. Articles are Internal, not Confidential\. · __Telemetry__ article\_searched \{term, result\_count\} · article\_viewed \{article\_id\} · __Surface__ web, admin · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-140, AC\-141, AC\-142 → M\-004

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-049 · Pending Approval status__

__Description__ The status a request holds while an approval is outstanding, and its effect on the SLA clock\.  
 __Source__ EV\-081 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ __Proposed__ in part \(P\-039 — the SLA effect is not stated in any source\) · __Applies to__ UC\-007, UC\-008

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST add Pending Approval to the status model in FR\-020, valid for service requests only\.  
 A request in Pending Approval MUST NOT be assignable or workable\.  
 The SLA clock MUST pause while a request is in Pending Approval, on the same basis as the waiting states in FR\-021\.  
 The system MUST record time spent awaiting approval separately, so approval latency is measurable\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-143 Given a request in Pending Approval, when a technician attempts to pick it up, then the action is refused\.  
 AC\-144 Given a request with a 2\-day SLA that sits 3 days in Pending Approval, when approved, then the full 2 days remain and approval latency reads 3 days\.  
 AC\-145 *\(negative\)* Given an incident, when Pending Approval is set, then it is refused — the status does not apply to incidents\.  
 *Fixture* approvals\_seed, sla\_targets\_seed · *Verification* AC\-144 requires clock manipulation\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Approval latency MUST be visible on the request, since it is frequently the largest component of total elapsed time\. · __Data__ Writes Ticket, History\. · __Telemetry__ approval\_latency \{seconds\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-020, FR\-021, FR\-041 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-143, AC\-144, AC\-145 → M\-006

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-050 · Service request fulfilment__

__Description__ How an approved service request is worked and closed\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Fulfilment differs from incident resolution in kind — provisioning a laptop is a sequence of provisioning steps, not a fix — but uses the same task, resolution and closure machinery\.  
 __Source__ EV\-078, EV\-089 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-007

__Functional requirements__  
 An approved service request MUST follow the assignment, task, resolution and closure behaviour specified in FR\-013 to FR\-033\.  
 Where fulfilment provisions an asset, the system MUST link the created or assigned asset to the request \(EV\-170\)\.  
 The system MUST NOT require a first\-contact\-resolution flag on a service request, since the concept does not apply to provisioning\.  
 Closure MUST require the same mandatory detail fields as an incident \(FR\-027\)\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-146 Given an approved service request for a laptop, when the technician assigns an asset during fulfilment, then that asset is linked to the request and visible on both records\.  
 AC\-147 Given a service request at closure, when the closure form renders, then no first\-contact\-resolution flag is required\.  
 AC\-148 *\(negative\)* Given a service request with an open fulfilment task, when Resolved is attempted, then it is refused and the open task is named\.  
 *Fixture* service\_requests\_seed, assets\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The asset link MUST be creatable from the request without navigating to the asset module\. · __Data__ Writes Ticket, Ticket\-Asset association, History\. · __Telemetry__ service\_request\_fulfilled \{asset\_linked: bool, elapsed\_sec\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-043, §15\.3 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-146, AC\-147, AC\-148 → M\-006

# __PRD · ISDT · 15\.3 Asset Management__

![](data:image/png;base64,)

__§15\.3 Asset Management__ · ISDT\-PRD1

23 functional requirements \(FR\-051 – FR\-073\) · 5 use cases · 3 diagrams · all traced to ISDT\-PRD1\-EVP\-001

## __Scope of this group__

The Executive Sponsor gave a specific rationale for asset management being in scope from the start: __every ticket should associate with an asset__ so device tracking is not missed, and the correlation between an asset and a reported issue is wanted from day one \(EV\-170\)\. The Frontend Engineer put the migration case more bluntly — the one thing genuinely needed from the old tool is asset data, because it cannot be re\-entered by hand \(EV\-186\)\.

This group covers the asset record and its five sections, ten lifecycle states, assignment and history, warranty and financials, hardware and software detail, licence tracking, and the provisioning and acknowledgement flow\. It does __not__ cover ticket\-side asset attachment, which is FR\-006 in §15\.1, nor the CMDB, which no session demonstrated\.

__This group specifies three deliberate corrections rather than replications\.__ EV\-117 — software licences hold counts only, with no link to the user or device consuming them\. EV\-115 — the base asset form and the hardware tab hold duplicate fields such as keyboard and mouse, which the administrator says should be de\-duplicated\. EV\-121 — the laptop agreement is printed and physically signed, which he wants automated\. Each is a limitation being fixed, not behaviour being carried across\.

## __Use cases__

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-011 · Provision an asset to a user__

__Actor__ Administrator or Technician · __Precondition__ An asset exists in IN STORE or IN STOCK

__Main success scenario__

1. Administrator selects an available asset\.
2. Administrator assigns it to exactly one user and records provision type — new provisioning, or replacement\.
3. The system emails the user asset detail and the agreement document\.
4. User acknowledges electronically\.
5. The asset moves to IN USE and history records both assignment and acknowledgement\.

__Extensions__ — 2a\. The administrator attempts to assign to two users or to a project → refused \(BR\-002\)\. 4a\. User denies because the stated specification does not match the delivered device → IT is notified with the discrepancy, the record is corrected, and a fresh acknowledgement is sought\. 4b\. User does not respond within the configured window → the asset still moves to IN USE, flagged as unacknowledged\.

__Postcondition__ The asset is IN USE against one named user, with the acknowledgement state recorded either way\.

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-012 · Recover an asset from a departing or returning user__

__Actor__ Administrator · __Precondition__ An asset is IN USE or PROJECT ASSIGNED

__Main success scenario__

1. The user returns the device to IT\.
2. Administrator records the return and its condition\.
3. The asset moves to IN STOCK, unassigned\.
4. Assignment history retains the previous holder and the dates held\.

__Extensions__ — 1a\. The user has left without returning it → the asset moves to WITH EMPLOYEE, a recovery queue rather than an assignment\. 2a\. The device is faulty on return → IN REPAIR, and on repair it returns to IN STOCK rather than to its previous holder\. 2b\. The device is beyond economic repair → SCRAP\.

__Postcondition__ The asset is in a state IT holds, and the full history of who held it and when survives\.

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-013 · Track software licence consumption__

__Actor__ Administrator · __Precondition__ A software licence record exists

__Main success scenario__

1. Administrator opens a software record and sees the licence count and how many are consumed\.
2. Administrator assigns a licence to a named user, a named device, or both\.
3. The system emails the associated agreement to that user for acknowledgement\.
4. Consumption count updates\.
5. Administrator can drill from the software to its holders, and from any user to every asset and licence they hold\.

__Extensions__ — 2a\. Assignment would exceed the licence count → refused, with the count and current consumption stated\. 4a\. The user leaves → their licences are surfaced for reclamation rather than silently orphaned\.

__Postcondition__ Licence consumption is attributable to named users or devices, not a bare number\.

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-014 · Chase the return of project\-loaned equipment__

__Actor__ Administrator · __Precondition__ Assets are PROJECT ASSIGNED with return dates

__Main success scenario__

1. Administrator runs a view of loans past or approaching their project end date\.
2. The system lists each asset with holder, project and days overdue\.
3. Administrator contacts the holders\.
4. Returned assets move to IN STOCK\.

__Extensions__ — 2a\. A project has no end date recorded → the loan is listed separately as open\-ended rather than omitted\.

__Postcondition__ Every outstanding loan is visible with its age\.

### __ISDT\-PRD1\-UC\-015 · Manage the estate through warranty and replacement__

__Actor__ Administrator · __Precondition__ Assets carry warranty and financial data

__Main success scenario__

1. Administrator receives a scheduled alert ahead of warranty expiry\.
2. Administrator reviews the assets entering the grey period between warranty end at year three and replacement at year four\.
3. For a fault in that window, administrator records the economic decision to repair or scrap\.
4. At year four the asset reaches zero book value and enters the replacement cycle\.

__Extensions__ — 1a\. No warranty end date is held → the asset appears in an exceptions list, not silently omitted from alerting\.

__Postcondition__ Warranty and replacement decisions are made ahead of expiry rather than on discovery of a fault\.

## __Functional requirements__

![](data:image/png;base64,)FR\-051 to FR\-057 · Record, identity, states and assignment 

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-051 · Asset record and sections__

__Description__ The asset record and its five standard sections: Details, Relationship, Contracts, Financials and History \(EV\-095\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-095 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved \(D\-003\) · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST hold an asset record carrying Details, Relationship, Contracts, Financials and History\.  
 The system MUST support asset product types covering at minimum laptop, desktop, server, virtual host, virtual machine, network equipment, printer and software\.  
 The system MUST allow an administrator to add product types without a code change \(G\-003\)\.  
 Every field change MUST write a history entry with actor and timestamp \(FR\-031\)\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-149 Given an asset of type laptop, when it is opened, then all five sections are present\.  
 AC\-150 Given an administrator adding a product type, when saved, then it is selectable on a new asset with no deployment\.  
 AC\-151 *\(negative\)* Given an asset with no product type, when saved, then it is refused and the field is named\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_seed — one asset per product type\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Sections MUST be navigable without scrolling through the whole record\. · __Data__ Writes Asset, History\. Asset is Internal; the assigned\-user linkage makes it indirectly identifying\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_created \{product\_type\} · asset\_updated \{fields\_changed\} · __Surface__ web, api, admin · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-149, AC\-150, AC\-151 → M\-005

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-052 · Asset tag and naming__

__Description__ Asset tags combine an organisation and site prefix with a six\-digit number, chosen so the range never exhausts \(EV\-094\)\. Bangalore covers WTC and Jayanagar; Noida uses an NCR prefix\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Name and asset tag are currently identical, and the administrator states an intention to separate them \(EV\-094\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-058, EV\-094 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-043 — separating name from tag is a stated intention, not current behaviour\) · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST generate an asset tag combining an organisation prefix, a site prefix and a six\-digit sequence\.  
 The system MUST hold asset name and asset tag as __separate fields__, and MUST NOT require them to match\.  
 The asset tag MUST be immutable once assigned\.  
 The system MUST refuse a duplicate asset tag\.  
 Prefixes MUST be configurable per site\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-152 Given a Bangalore site prefix, when an asset is created there, then its tag carries that prefix and the next sequence number\.  
 AC\-153 Given an asset with a tag, when an administrator edits the name, then the tag is unchanged\.  
 AC\-154 *\(negative\)* Given an existing tag, when an administrator attempts to create an asset with the same tag, then it is refused\.  
 AC\-155 *\(negative\)* Given an existing asset, when an administrator attempts to change its tag, then the change is refused\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_sites\_seed — one asset per configured site\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Tag and name MUST both be visible in list views; showing only one loses the ability to search by either\. · __Data__ Writes Asset\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_tag\_generated \{site\_prefix\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-003, C\-008 → AC\-152, AC\-153, AC\-154, AC\-155 → M\-003

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-053 · Asset states__

__Description__ The ten states an asset may hold\. __See Diagram 8\.__  
 __Use case and benefits__ Two pairs are easily conflated and both matter operationally: __In Store__ is sealed and new while __In Stock__ is returned from a user; __With Employee__ is a recovery queue rather than an assignment \(EV\-093\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-093 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-011, UC\-012

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST support states In Store, In Use, In Stock, In Repair, Deployed, Expired, Scrap, Disposed, With Employee and Project Assigned\.  
 The system MUST distinguish In Store from In Stock in every list, filter and report\.  
 Disposed MUST be terminal; a disposed asset MUST NOT be reissued\.  
 States MUST be extensible by an administrator without a code change\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-156 Given a new sealed device, when it is received, then its state is In Store and not In Stock\.  
 AC\-157 Given a device returned by a user, when the return is recorded, then its state is In Stock and not In Store\.  
 AC\-158 *\(negative\)* Given a Disposed asset, when an administrator attempts to assign it to a user, then it is refused\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_states\_seed — one asset in each of the ten states\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ In Store and In Stock MUST NOT be adjacent in any dropdown without a distinguishing description\. · __Data__ Writes Asset, History\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_state\_changed \{from, to\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-156, AC\-157, AC\-158 → M\-005

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-054 · State transitions and the scrap cycle__

__Description__ Which state changes are legal, and the yearly scrap cycle \(EV\-093\)\. __See Diagram 8\.__  
 __Source__ EV\-093 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-040 — the states are sourced; the transition set between them is a design act\) · __Applies to__ UC\-012

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST NOT permit a transition absent from Diagram 8\.  
 A repaired asset MUST return to In Stock rather than directly to its previous holder; reissue MUST be a deliberate act\.  
 The system MUST support a scrap cycle that moves Scrap assets to Disposed in a single reviewed operation\.  
 The system MUST require a reason on any transition to Scrap or Disposed\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-159 Given an asset In Repair, when repair is recorded complete, then its state is In Stock and it is unassigned\.  
 AC\-160 *\(negative\)* Given an asset In Store, when a transition directly to Disposed is attempted, then it is refused\.  
 AC\-161 Given 30 assets in Scrap, when the yearly cycle runs and is confirmed, then all 30 are Disposed and 30 history entries exist\.  
 AC\-162 *\(negative\)* Given a transition to Scrap with an empty reason, when saved, then it is refused\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_states\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Only legal next states MUST be offered\. · __Data__ Writes Asset, History\. __Reversibility__ Disposed is irreversible\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_scrap\_cycle\_run \{count\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-053 · __Surface__ web, api, admin · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-159, AC\-160, AC\-161, AC\-162 → M\-005

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-055 · Single\-user assignment__

__Description__ One asset maps to exactly one user\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Project or department level ownership was previously possible and was __prohibited by an audit finding about two years ago__; shared assets are now assigned to the lead or requester \(EV\-097\)\. This is a compliance constraint, not a preference\.  
 __Source__ EV\-097 · BR\-002, C\-003 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST permit at most one assigned user per asset\.  
 The system MUST NOT permit assignment to a project, department, group or shared identity\.  
 A shared item such as a printer MUST use the Deployed state and MUST still carry a single accountable user\.  
 Reassignment MUST close the previous assignment with an end date rather than overwrite it\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-163 Given an asset assigned to one user, when an administrator assigns it to a second, then the first assignment is closed with an end date and the second opens\.  
 AC\-164 *\(negative\)* Given an asset, when an administrator attempts to assign it to a department, then it is refused with BR\-002 stated\.  
 AC\-165 *\(negative\)* Given an asset, when a second concurrent assignment is attempted through the API, then it returns an error and only one assignment exists\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_seed, users\_sites\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The single\-owner rule MUST be stated at the point of assignment, since it is counter\-intuitive for shared equipment\. · __Data__ Writes Asset, Assignment, History\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_assigned \{previous\_holder: bool\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-053 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006, C\-003 → AC\-163, AC\-164, AC\-165 → M\-006

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-056 · Assignment and state history__

__Description__ The full record of who held an asset, when, and what state it was in\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ The Product Manager raised the case of an asset moving between projects and users over time; the answer is state history and assignment history views \(EV\-098\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-095, EV\-098 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-012

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST hold assignment history — holder, start date, end date, and the reason the assignment ended\.  
 The system MUST hold state history — state, entered, exited, and actor\.  
 Both MUST be append\-only and MUST NOT be editable by any role\.  
 Both MUST survive reassignment, repair and disposal\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-166 Given an asset held by three users in sequence, when history is opened, then all three appear with their date ranges\.  
 AC\-167 *\(negative\)* Given an administrator, when they attempt to delete an assignment history entry, then it is refused\.  
 AC\-168 Given a Disposed asset, when its history is opened, then every prior holder and state is still visible\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_history\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Assignment and state history MUST be separately viewable; interleaving them obscures both\. · __Data__ Writes History — append\-only, Confidential, holder identity is PII\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_history\_viewed \{view\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-055 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006, C\-002 → AC\-166, AC\-167, AC\-168 → M\-006

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-057 · Primary device, secondary device and project loan__

__Description__ Additional user information recording whether the asset is a primary or secondary device, the project name, and project start and end dates \(EV\-096\)\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ These dates are used to chase the return of project\-loaned equipment through a custom report \(EV\-096\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-096 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-014

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST record primary or secondary designation on an assignment\.  
 The system MUST record project name, project start and project end on a Project Assigned asset\.  
 The system MUST provide a view of loans past or approaching their project end date, with days overdue\.  
 A loan with no end date MUST be listed separately as open\-ended, and MUST NOT be omitted\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-169 Given three assets with project end dates in the past, when the overdue view is opened, then all three appear with holder, project and days overdue\.  
 AC\-170 *\(boundary\)* Given a loan with no end date, when the overdue view is opened, then it appears in the open\-ended list rather than being absent\.  
 AC\-171 Given a user holding a primary and a secondary device, when their record is opened, then both are listed with their designation\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_project\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The overdue view MUST be a standing view, not a report the administrator must remember to build\. · __Data__ Writes Assignment\. · __Telemetry__ loan\_overdue\_viewed \{overdue\_count, open\_ended\_count\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-055 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-004 → AC\-169, AC\-170, AC\-171 → M\-004

![](data:image/png;base64,)FR\-058 to FR\-063 · Warranty, financials, hardware detail 

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-058 · Warranty tracking and expiry alerting__

__Description__ Warranty dates per asset, with alerting ahead of expiry\. Defaults are three years for laptops and one to two years for access points \(EV\-095\); scheduled reports can alert ahead of warranty or subscription expiry \(EV\-149\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-095, EV\-149 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-015

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST hold warranty start and end dates per asset, defaulting by product type\.  
 The system MUST alert ahead of warranty expiry at a configurable lead time\.  
 The system MUST provide a view of assets by warranty expiry window\.  
 Assets with no warranty end date MUST appear in an exceptions list rather than being silently excluded from alerting\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-172 Given a laptop created with no explicit warranty, when saved, then warranty end defaults to three years from warranty start\.  
 AC\-173 Given a 30\-day lead time and an asset expiring in 30 days, when the scheduled job runs, then an alert is raised once\.  
 AC\-174 *\(negative\)* Given an asset with no warranty end date, when the expiry view is opened, then it appears in the exceptions list\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_warranty\_seed · *Verification* AC\-173 requires clock manipulation\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The expiry view MUST default to the next 90 days rather than requiring a date range on every use\. · __Data__ Reads Asset; writes alert record\. · __Telemetry__ warranty\_alert\_raised \{days\_ahead, asset\_count\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051 · __Surface__ web, batch · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-172, AC\-173, AC\-174 → M\-006

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-059 · Financials, depreciation and the grey period__

__Description__ Asset value, depreciation, and the window between warranty end and scheduled replacement\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Policy replaces hardware every four years, so 25% per year reaches zero at year four \(EV\-099\)\. A __grey period__ exists between the three\-year warranty end and the four\-year replacement, during which repair costs fall on Celestial's budget and an economic decision is taken \(EV\-100\)\. The administrator states the facility is __not used effectively__ today \(EV\-099\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-099, EV\-100 · BR\-006 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-015

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST hold asset value and depreciation rate, defaulting to 25% per year per BR\-006\.  
 The system MUST compute current book value from purchase date, value and rate\.  
 The system MUST identify assets in the grey period — past warranty end, before scheduled replacement\.  
 For a fault on a grey\-period asset the system MUST allow a repair\-or\-scrap decision to be recorded with its cost\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-175 Given an asset purchased at 100,000 with 25% annual depreciation, when viewed at two years, then book value reads 50,000\.  
 AC\-176 *\(boundary\)* Given the same asset at four years, when viewed, then book value reads zero and does not go negative\.  
 AC\-177 Given an asset past warranty end and before year four, when the grey\-period view is opened, then it appears\.  
 AC\-178 Given a grey\-period fault, when a repair decision is recorded with a cost, then both decision and cost appear in history\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_financial\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Book value MUST show its inputs, since the figure is otherwise unverifiable by the person reading it\. · __Data__ Writes Asset, History\. Financial data is Confidential\. · __Telemetry__ grey\_period\_decision \{outcome, cost\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-058 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-175, AC\-176, AC\-177, AC\-178 → M\-006

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-060 · Hardware and software detail__

__Description__ Laptops carry two additional tabs beyond the standard form — Hardware and Software — covering operating system, memory, BIOS, processor cores and hyperthreading, RAM slots, network cards, disks, logical and physical drives, peripherals, sound, USB, ports and graphics, plus installed software and service packs \(EV\-113\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-113 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST hold hardware detail per the field set at EV\-113 for applicable product types\.  
 The system MUST hold installed software and service pack detail\.  
 Hardware detail MUST be enterable by hand; automatic population MUST NOT be a precondition for the field existing\.  
 Fields not applicable to a product type MUST NOT render on it\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-179 Given a laptop, when opened, then Hardware and Software sections are present\.  
 AC\-180 *\(negative\)* Given a printer, when opened, then processor and RAM\-slot fields do not render\.  
 AC\-181 Given hardware detail entered by hand, when saved, then it persists and is reportable\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_hardware\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The hardware tab MUST NOT be presented as mandatory; most of the estate will carry partial detail\. · __Data__ Writes Asset\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_hardware\_updated \{source: manual | import\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051, FR\-061 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-179, AC\-180, AC\-181 → M\-005

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-061 · Field de\-duplication__

__Description__ A field appears once\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ The base asset form and the hardware tab hold __duplicate fields such as keyboard and mouse__, and the administrator states these should be de\-duplicated in the new tool \(EV\-115\)\. Duplicated fields diverge, and then nobody knows which is right\.  
 __Source__ EV\-115 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ Approved \(EV\-115, stated want\) · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST hold each asset attribute exactly once across the whole record\.  
 Where an attribute is relevant on more than one section, both MUST read and write the same underlying field\.  
 The system MUST NOT present two separately editable fields carrying the same meaning\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-182 Given an asset with a keyboard attribute shown on two sections, when it is edited on one, then the other shows the same value immediately\.  
 AC\-183 *\(negative\)* Given the asset schema, when inspected, then no two fields carry the same attribute name and meaning\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_hardware\_seed · *Verification* AC\-183 is a schema assertion in CI, not a UI test\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Where an attribute appears twice for convenience, the second MUST be visibly a mirror rather than an independent entry point\. · __Data__ Asset schema constraint\. · __Telemetry__ none\. · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-003 → AC\-182, AC\-183 → M\-003

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-062 · Cross\-platform inventory parity__

__Description__ Any automatic inventory capability must work on Windows, macOS and Ubuntu LTS, or not be built\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ A vendor script auto\-populates Windows hardware detail but is __not used__, because no mature equivalent exists for Mac or Linux and Celestial wants parity across all three \(EV\-114\)\. The network\-scanning agent is unused for the same reason \(EV\-101\) and is a non\-goal \(NG\-007\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-101, EV\-114 · C\-007 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ __Proposed__ \(P\-044 — the parity constraint is sourced; whether any automatic inventory is built at all is not decided\) · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 Any automatic hardware inventory capability MUST achieve equivalent coverage on Windows, macOS and Ubuntu LTS\.  
 The system MUST NOT ship a platform\-specific inventory mechanism that leaves part of the estate unmanaged\.  
 Where automatic inventory is absent for a platform, manual entry MUST remain fully supported \(FR\-060\)\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-184 Given automatic inventory is implemented, when run against a Windows, a macOS and an Ubuntu device, then equivalent field sets are populated on all three\.  
 AC\-185 *\(negative\)* Given a platform with no automatic inventory, when an asset of that platform is created, then every hardware field remains manually editable\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_platform\_seed — one device per platform\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield; the mechanism is an architecture decision\. · __UX__ The source of each hardware value — manual or automatic — MUST be visible\. · __Data__ Writes Asset\. · __Telemetry__ inventory\_collected \{platform, fields\_populated\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-060 · __Surface__ batch · __Traces__ C\-007 → AC\-184, AC\-185 → M\-005

OQ\-020__ is unresolved and bears directly on this\.__ Whether the vendor's Windows inventory script has any Mac or Linux equivalent is unobservable from outside and was never answered\. Until it is, FR\-062 constrains a capability whose feasibility is unknown\.

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-063 · Server and virtual host classification__

__Description__ A bare\-metal operating system install is classified as a __Server__; a hypervisor install as a __Virtual Host__\. Virtual machines must each link to a virtual host \(EV\-116\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-116 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST distinguish product types Server, Virtual Host and Virtual Machine\.  
 Every Virtual Machine MUST link to exactly one Virtual Host\.  
 The system MUST refuse creation of a Virtual Machine with no host\.  
 The system MUST show, from a Virtual Host, every Virtual Machine it carries\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-186 Given a Virtual Host, when a Virtual Machine is created against it, then the link exists and is visible from both records\.  
 AC\-187 *\(negative\)* Given no host selected, when a Virtual Machine is saved, then it is refused and the host field is named\.  
 AC\-188 *\(negative\)* Given a Virtual Host carrying four Virtual Machines, when disposal is attempted, then it is refused until the machines are reassigned or disposed\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_virtual\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The host\-to\-machine relationship MUST be navigable in both directions\. · __Data__ Writes Asset, Asset relationship\. · __Telemetry__ vm\_linked \{host\_id\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-186, AC\-187, AC\-188 → M\-005

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-064 · Software licence records__

__Description__ Software as a tracked asset class\. Tracking began around May 2026 driven by an audit; roughly 49 records exist, expected to reach 70 to 80, with the existing inventory held in spreadsheets awaiting import \(EV\-102\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-102 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-013

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST hold a software licence record carrying product, vendor, licence count, purchase and expiry dates and agreement document\.  
 The system MUST support the Expired state for lapsed subscriptions \(FR\-053\)\.  
 The system MUST alert ahead of subscription expiry on the same basis as warranty \(FR\-058\)\.  
 The system MUST import existing software inventory from a spreadsheet \(FR\-070\)\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-189 Given a software record with an expiry date, when the lead\-time window is reached, then an alert is raised\.  
 AC\-190 Given a spreadsheet of 49 software records, when imported, then all 49 exist with their counts\.  
 AC\-191 *\(boundary\)* Given a subscription past its expiry date, when the scheduled job runs, then its state becomes Expired\.  
 *Fixture* software\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Software MUST be filterable separately from hardware in every list\. · __Data__ Writes Asset\. Agreement documents may be Confidential\. · __Telemetry__ software\_expiry\_alert · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051 · __Surface__ web, api, batch · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-189, AC\-190, AC\-191 → M\-005

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-065 · Licence consumption linkage__

__Description__ A licence links to the user or device consuming it\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ Today __software licences hold counts only__ — there is no link from a licence to the user or device consuming it \(EV\-117\)\. That makes reclamation on departure impossible and audit answers guesswork\. __See Diagram 10\.__  
 __Source__ EV\-117 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved \(EV\-118, stated requirement for the new tool\) · __Applies to__ UC\-013

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST link each consumed licence to a named user, a named device, or both\.  
 The system MUST compute consumed and remaining counts from those links rather than from a manually maintained number\.  
 The system MUST refuse an assignment that would exceed the licence count, stating count and current consumption\.  
 When a user's assignment ends, the system MUST surface their held licences for reclamation rather than silently orphaning them\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-192 Given a licence with a count of 10 and 7 assigned, when the record is opened, then remaining reads 3 and the 7 holders are listed\.  
 AC\-193 *\(negative\)* Given a licence fully consumed, when an eleventh assignment is attempted, then it is refused with count and consumption stated\.  
 AC\-194 Given a user holding two licences, when their assignments are ended, then both licences appear in the reclamation list\.  
 *Fixture* software\_licences\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Remaining count MUST be visible without opening the holder list\. · __Data__ Writes Licence assignment, History\. Holder identity is PII\. · __Telemetry__ licence\_assigned \{remaining\} · licence\_reclamation\_listed \{count\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-064 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-192, AC\-193, AC\-194 → M\-006

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-066 · Bidirectional drill\-down__

__Description__ Per software, which users hold it; per user, every asset and licence assigned \(EV\-118\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-118 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved \(EV\-118, stated requirement\) · __Applies to__ UC\-013

__Functional requirements__  
 From a software record the system MUST show how many and which users hold it\.  
 From a user record the system MUST show every asset and every licence assigned to them\.  
 Both views MUST be exportable\.  
 Both MUST reflect current assignment, with historical holders reachable through history\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-195 Given a software product held by 7 users, when its record is opened, then all 7 are listed by name\.  
 AC\-196 Given a user holding two assets and three licences, when their record is opened, then all five appear\.  
 AC\-197 *\(negative\)* Given a user whose licence was reclaimed last month, when their current view is opened, then it does not appear there but is present in history\.  
 *Fixture* software\_licences\_seed, assets\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The per\-user view MUST be reachable from a ticket, since that is where the question usually arises\. · __Data__ Reads Asset, Licence assignment\. Holder lists are PII and MUST respect §15\.7 visibility\. · __Telemetry__ drilldown\_viewed \{direction\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-065 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-195, AC\-196, AC\-197 → M\-006

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-067 · Asset provisioning notification__

__Description__ The user is emailed asset detail and provision type when an asset is assigned \(FLOW\-005\)\. __See Diagram 9\.__  
 __Source__ EV\-195 · FLOW\-005 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 On assignment the system MUST email the user asset detail and provision type — new provisioning, or replacement for an existing user\.  
 The notification MUST carry the stated specification, so a mismatch is detectable by the recipient\.  
 On deprovisioning the system MUST notify the user and IT\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-198 Given an asset assigned as a replacement, when assignment completes, then the user receives a notification stating provision type replacement and the asset specification\.  
 AC\-199 Given an asset deprovisioned, when the state changes, then both user and IT are notified\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_seed, users\_sites\_seed

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The specification in the notification MUST be the same data the acknowledgement is judged against, not a summary\. · __Data__ Reads Asset; writes notification record\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_provision\_notified \{provision\_type\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-055 · __Surface__ batch · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-198, AC\-199 → M\-005

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-068 · Asset acknowledgement with a deny path__

__Description__ The user acknowledges or __denies__ receipt, with IT notified either way\. __See Diagram 9\.__  
 __Use case and benefits__ The stated requirement is explicit and comes with its own worked example: a form stating 16GB against a delivered laptop with a different specification, with IT notified either way so the record can be corrected \(EV\-120\)\. When the Frontend Engineer compared this to the existing HR usage\-policy acknowledgement, the administrator distinguished it — that one is acknowledge\-only, __this one needs a deny path__ \(EV\-122\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-120, EV\-122 · __Priority__ P1 · __Status__ Approved \(EV\-120, stated requirement\) · __Applies to__ UC\-011

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST offer the user both acknowledge and deny\.  
 A denial MUST require a stated discrepancy\.  
 The system MUST notify IT on __both__ outcomes\.  
 A denial MUST NOT block the assignment; the asset still moves to In Use, flagged pending correction\.  
 Where the user does not respond within the configured window, the asset MUST be flagged unacknowledged rather than assumed acknowledged\.

__Acceptance criteria__  
 AC\-200 Given a provisioned asset, when the user acknowledges, then the acknowledgement is recorded with timestamp and IT is notified\.  
 AC\-201 Given the same asset, when the user denies stating the memory does not match, then IT is notified with that discrepancy and the asset is flagged pending correction\.  
 AC\-202 *\(negative\)* Given a denial with no discrepancy stated, when submitted, then it is refused\.  
 AC\-203 *\(boundary\)* Given no response within the window, when the window closes, then the asset is flagged unacknowledged and is not recorded as acknowledged\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_acknowledgement\_seed · *Verification* AC\-203 requires clock manipulation\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ Deny MUST be as prominent as acknowledge\. An acknowledge\-only\-shaped screen with a small deny link recreates the problem this requirement exists to solve\. · __Data__ Writes Acknowledgement, Asset, History\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_acknowledged · asset\_denied \{discrepancy\_length\} · asset\_unacknowledged · __Prerequisites__ FR\-067 · __Surface__ web, api · __Traces__ G\-006 → AC\-200, AC\-201, AC\-202, AC\-203 → M\-006

__Description__ When software is assigned to a user, the associated agreement is emailed to that user for acknowledgement \(EV\-119\)\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ The laptop agreement form is currently __printed and physically signed__, and the administrator wants this automated \(EV\-121\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-119, EV\-121 · __Priority__ P2 · __Status__ Approved \(EV\-119, stated requirement\) · __Applies to__ UC\-013

__Functional requirements__  
 On licence assignment the system MUST email the associated agreement document to the user for acknowledgement\.

#### __ISDT\-PRD1\-FR\-070 · Asset import and export__

__Description__ Bulk import of the existing estate, and export of everything held\.  
 __Use case and benefits__ This is the single most important migration requirement in the PRD\. The Frontend Engineer's pragmatic scope statement was that __the one thing genuinely needed from the old tool is asset data, because it cannot be re\-entered by hand__ \(EV\-186\)\. Module export exists and produces CSV \(EV\-041\), and the administrator noted module export may suffice for assets specifically \(EV\-185\)\.  
 __Source__ EV\-041, EV\-102, EV\-185, EV\-186 · C\-005, C\-006 · __Priority__ P0 · __Status__ Approved \(EV\-065\) · __Applies to__ UC\-013

__Functional requirements__  
 The system MUST import assets and software records in bulk from CSV or spreadsheet\.  
 The system MUST validate every row before applying anything and MUST report the change set for confirmation\.

 AC\-209 Given an imported estate, when exported, then every field held is present including those never populated\.  
 AC\-210 *\(negative\)* Given a CSV containing a duplicate asset tag, when imported, then the duplicate row is rejected and named\.  
 *Fixture* assets\_import\_seed — valid 680\-row file, file with 12 invalid rows, file with one duplicate tag\.  
 *Verification* AC\-207 runs within the bulk operation budget in FR\-007\.

__Technical__ Not applicable — greenfield\. · __UX__ The change set MUST distinguish create, update and reject before confirmation\. · __Data__ Writes Asset, History\. · __Telemetry__ asset\_import \{created, updated, rejected\} · asset\_export \{row\_count\} · __Prerequisites__ FR\-051, FR\-052 · __Surface__ admin, api · __Traces__ G\-005, G\-007, C\-005, C\-006 → AC\-207, AC\-208, AC\-209, AC\-210 → M\-005, M\-007

__Description__ The number of assets tracked is bounded by nothing but storage\.

 The system MUST NOT impose a licensed or configured ceiling on the number of assets\.

__Description__ The association between an asset and the tickets raised about it\.

 The system MUST hold a many\-to\-many association between assets and tickets\.

# __PRD · ISDT · 15\.4 Change Management__

__§15\.4 Change Management__ · ISDT\-PRD1

20 functional requirements \(FR\-074 – FR\-093\) · 5 use cases · 3 diagrams · all traced to ISDT\-PRD1\-EVP\-001

__This is the group the Executive Sponsor named specifically\.__ EV\-167: the existing change workflow *"is very complicated and took two to three months to perfect, and that complexity must not be carried across\. The team should understand the workflow then design a simpler one\."*

So this group does __not__ specify the incumbent's eight stages\. It specifies a __five\-stage target__ and retains the current workflow verbatim as an appendix, so nothing is lost and the simplification is reviewable rather than assumed\. __See Diagram 11\.__

## __Scope of this group__

Change requests are raised only by administrator or technician users — there is no end\-user access and no plan to open it \(EV\-124\)\. The module covers hardware and software replacement, upgrade, new provisioning, and internal tool customisation\. It is used today by IT and Infosec, with a stated plan to extend to Admin and HR \(EV\-128\)\.

Note the Sponsor also deferred change management to post\-October \(EV\-169\)\. Per D\-003 that sequencing is recorded as an input to the phasing decision, not applied here as a scope cut — the capability is specified so the team can decide what to defer from a complete picture\.
